map.五段表达式由各字段状态拼装：每字段「任意」输出 *、「最后」输出 L、「指定」把: Build the five-field expression from each field state: Any → *, Last → L, Specific → comma-joined values (→ * if none), Range → start-end, Step → */step when start equals the field minimum (1 for day and month), otherwise start/step. Reverse parsing: split on whitespace into five fields; a value with / is a step (start = field minimum when *), with - and no comma is a range, otherwise specific or any. Matching: * and ? always true; L compares with the last day of the month (new Date(year, month+1, 0).getDate()); / requires value ≥ start and (value − start) mod step = 0; - requires the value inside the closed range; otherwise exact match. Next runs start one minute after now with seconds/milliseconds zeroed, advance minute by minute, check minute/hour/day/month/weekday, collect the first 10 matches, up to 100,000 iterations; an expression without five fields reports a format error.
